criterion: Pass = the page shows what the prompt asked for, running on its own, judged by watching the whole recorded clip (frames every 2.5 s, full-size crops where small). One try per model; a run is re-made only when the answer was cut off by our setup (token cap / provider default), never because the result was bad.
reruns: gpt-oss-20b: first answers stopped at Groq's default 2,048 output tokens (finish_reason length) -> both gpt-oss models re-run on all 5 tasks with the same 16,000 allowance; all 10 finished with finish_reason stop
Gemini: rate-limited (429) attempts on other model ids were retried; every scored Gemini run is gemini-3.8-flash

excluded.qwen: Qwen 3.8 27B on Groq: our tier rejects requests reserving more than about 6,000 output tokens ('Request too large'); with a 6,000 cap every answer stopped mid-code (finish_reason length) on all 5 tasks. Not a fair test of the model, so not scored.
